text: The current speed limit on Wallace Avenue, between Dufferin Street and Lansdowne Avenue, is 40 km/h. This stretch of Wallace Avenue was never reduced in 2015/2016 when the speed limit was reduced to 30 km/h in neighbourhood across Toronto. This section of Wallace Avenue is heavily used by motorists, cyclists and pedestrians, who travel to daily local schools. Several area residents have raised concerns over excessive traffic volumes and speeding on Wallace Avenue. As traffic fatalities are dramatically reduced when vehicles operate at 30 km/h, the purpose of this motion seeks to lower the current speed limit on Wallace Avenue, between Dufferin Street and Lansdowne Avenue, from 40 km/h to 30 km/h.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to reduce the speed limit on Wallace Avenue, between Dufferin Street and Lansdowne Avenue, from 40 km/h to 30 km/h.
